tasks.title: Create the Gradle multi-project structure, the Spring Boot entry point and the 13 empty Modulith module packages + the shared kernel
tasks.dod: `./gradlew build` succeeds on the empty skeleton: settings.gradle.kts includes backend:app, backend:telegram-tdlib and frontend; backend/app applies spring.kotlin.service.conventions + spring.modulith.conventions + spring.ai.conventions + kotlin.detekt.conventions; TelexApplication boots; each of web, identity, messaging, triage, agents, tools, tasks, scheduling, audit, telegram, llm, decision, bot has a package-info.java with @ApplicationModule(allowedDependencies) per the map; telex.shared is an OPEN module; backend/telegram-tdlib applies spring.kotlin.module.conventions and exposes only an empty facade package telex.telegram.tdlib

tasks.title: Wire the backend test harness: unit tests with ModularityTest, an integrationTest JVM test suite with Testcontainers, and the app-boots smoke test
tasks.dod: `./gradlew test` runs green without Docker and includes ModularityTest (ApplicationModules.verify() passes and writes the module documentation); `./gradlew integrationTest` runs a @SpringBootTest smoke test that boots the app against a Testcontainers pgvector Postgres; `./gradlew check` depends on integrationTest; the test-suite setup lives in a build-logic convention, not in backend/app

tasks.title: Set up Flyway with a baseline migration and its rollback script, the rollback test, and compose.yaml with Postgres + pgvector
tasks.dod: V202609300000__baseline.sql enables the vector extension and creates the Spring Modulith event_publication table; U202609300000__baseline.sql reverts it; MigrationRollbackIT applies up -> down -> up cleanly on Testcontainers; `docker compose up -d` at the repo root starts pgvector Postgres and the app connects to it with the local profile

tasks.title: Establish the shared conventions in code: UUIDv7 typed ids and the RFC 9457 problem handler
tasks.dod: telex.shared exposes a UUIDv7 generator + a base for typed id value classes, with unit tests for time-ordering and version bits; telex.web has one @RestControllerAdvice that renders application/problem+json with `code` and `errors[]` extensions and type urn:telex:error:<code>, with a unit/slice test; ModularityTest still passes

tasks.title: Create the React + TypeScript + Vite + Tabler frontend as a pnpm workspace package, built by Gradle and served by Spring Web
tasks.dod: Root build.gradle.kts defines :pnpmInstall and pnpm-workspace.yaml lists frontend; frontend/ applies pnpm.conventions; `pnpm run check` runs tsc --noEmit + ESLint + Prettier check + Vitest (one smoke test) green; `pnpm run build` output is copied into backend/app's static resources; an integration smoke test gets index.html from GET / and falls back to it for client-side routes; @tabler/core and @tabler/icons-react are installed and the app shell renders one placeholder page

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow (build + unit + integration tests + lint for backend and frontend)
tasks.dod: .github/workflows/ci.yml is valid, sets up JDK 25 and pnpm, caches Gradle and pnpm, and runs `./gradlew build integrationTest` (which includes spotlessCheck, detekt and pnpm check); commands match the map's machine keys

tasks.title: Update CLAUDE.md from the foundation map: real commands, layout and conventions
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md reflects docs/architecture-map.md: build/test/integrationTest/lint commands that actually work, single-test command, module layout under backend/app, telegram-tdlib isolation, migration + rollback convention, error and id conventions, frontend commands; no 'pre-code' wording remains
